claim: Costco's net income topped $1.6 billion in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024.
summary: Whether Costco's calendar Q4 2024 net income exceeded $1.6B cannot be established from known fiscal-quarter reporting alone.

sub_claims.text: Costco's net income topped $1.6 billion in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024.

sub_claims.note: Costco reports on a fiscal year ending in Aug/Sep, not calendar quarters. No calendar Q4 2024 net income figure is established in knowledge; fiscal Q1 FY2025 and Q2 FY2025 figures cannot be directly equated to calendar Q4 without monthly breakdown.
